text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Take a look at that! Yukino Bijin's still
got it!
Makes sense consider her
performance in the
Classics.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: What a race! I'm glad I got to see it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(They're cheer'n! For me! The real me!
But t'be
honest, I was hop'n for a bit
more hoopla.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Guess I still haven't won over ev'ryone's
hearts
yet.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Who knew trendsett'n would be this
hard! Do I
really got what it takes?)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh... maybe I've bitten off more'n I
can chew.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But I hafta b'lieve it'll all work out!
B'sides, it
doesn't hafta happen all at
once.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(It's like Granny used t'say, "Life's a
marathon,
not a sprint!")

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It'll be okay as long as I keep runn'n!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo! Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Was that?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Hometown Re...
text_block_list.text:
Yukino! You're the coolest cat on the
track!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Hometown Re...
text_block_list.text:
She zipped down the track lickety-split!
I can't believe our li'l Yukino's grown
into such a sensation! Come on,
ev'ryone! Show her s'more
love!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Hometown Re...
text_block_list.text: Yukino! You did iiiit!

text_block_list.name: Banner
text_block_list.text:
Go, Yukino Bijin! You're the Star of
Morioka!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Zounds! Is that ev'ryone from back
home?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I mean... this is Kansai, y'know! You came all this way from Morioka?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Hometown Re...
text_block_list.text:
Of course! We'd go all the way to
Timbuktu for
you, Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Hometown Re...
text_block_list.text:
Your trainer contacted us and said
y'were hav'n a
tough time, so we figured
we'd come and cheer
you on directly!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Hometown Re...
text_block_list.text:
We've always got your back, Yukino!
Don't get
lost in your head too much!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You guys...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks oodles. You're right.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I can't let m'self get dragged down! I
gotta press
on with all my might!

text_block_list.name: Harp Alpha
text_block_list.text: ...Which one of us is really shining?

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I believe in you, Harp Alpha. I really do.
But... if
this is starting to be too much—

text_block_list.name: Harp Alpha
text_block_list.text:
I can't stop now, Trainer. I have to keep
running. I
want to believe in myself a
little longer...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Ev'ryone from back home came
t'see me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I keep in regular contact with her
parents. I might have mentioned that
she's been struggling lately, but I never
imagined they'd make the trek out
here.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It can be stifl'n sometimes, but I'm
thankful.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Seeing ev'ryone's faces makes me so
happy, I
could jump to the moon.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It makes me feel like I can keep on
keep'n on!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Righty-o!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's do our best next ti...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanna run in a buncha G1s! That way I
can
dazzle even brighter!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin's smiling face exudes
confidence. She's a completely different
racer from when she
ran the Hanshin
Juvenile Fillies.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Victoria Mile is popular among
racers who've run the Triple Tiara. The
lineup there is sure to be
just as bright
as Yukino Bijin hopes for.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Golly! Then maybe I'll come out of it
shin'n like a
diamond!
choice_data_list: Maybe I can improve myself even fu...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like a plan, Stan! Let's go to the
Victoria
Mile!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we decide to set our sights on
the
Victoria Mile.
